basis.clock: SU / VM serial domain 0.9 GHz, SS setup / FF hold, 60/25 ps
basis.distances: Manhattan, rectangle-bound (W18b): no pin plan inside the strip; M1-M5 in the strip, M1-M7 in the SU halves; the reach is W15's routed figure, not re-measured on M5
basis.rotate_span: every (bank slot, lane) pair is realised by some base, so the fixed pipeline pays the hub's farthest bank -> farthest lane distance on every op

row_aligned_only.note: NOT a fixed pipeline: the stages a base = 0 mod 1,024 op would need; the ruling's fixed-latency strip pays the worst case on every op

reach_481um.note: 481 um a stage (W18b commit 32155a8f / W16b); not used for the RTL

design_keys.note: control_broadcast is controller -> strip (the address); the control word to the lanes (control_word_to_lanes) rides in parallel, inside control_broadcast + operand_read

per_su_op.basis: emit -> strip read (CR_LEAD) -> lanes (CR_RD) ... lanes -> strip (CR_WR | CR_RES); the controller -> lane control word (controller_to_farthest_tile) rides in parallel

compared_to_priced.compact_assumption: every lane within ~3,850 um of the strip: 8 stages each way, su_op_extra ~21
compared_to_priced.finding: the 3,850 um framing bounds the lane -> strip-edge leg only; the rotate moves data along the strip's full height, so the worst bank -> lane leg is the hub's 10,735 um
